final_announce: Announce: relevant=[object 0, object 1, object 2, object 4]; rule=all four objects must be included together regardless of other objects
Announce: relevant=[object 3, object 4, object 5]; rule=the device turns on if and only if at least six objects are placed on it and object 3, object 4, and object 5 are among them
Announce: relevant=[object 0, object 1, object 4, object 7]; rule=the device turns on when objects 0, 1, 4, and 7 are all placed together, regardless of additional objects.

Announce: relevant=[object 0, object 1, object 2, object 3, object 4, object 5, object 6, object 7]; rule=the device turns on when all objects are placed together, or when exactly seven objects are placed and the sum of their indices is divisible by 3.
Announce: relevant=[object 3, object 4, object 5]; rule=the device turns on when objects 3, 4, and 5 are all placed together.
Announce: relevant=[object 0, object 1, object 6]; rule=all three objects must be present together
Announce: relevant=[object 0, object 4, object 5, object 7]; rule=All objects initially on the floor must be placed on the device.
Announce: relevant=[object 0, object 4, object 6]; rule=the device turns on if and only if objects 0, 4, and 6 are all present
Announce: relevant=[object 1, object 2, object 3, object 4]; rule=the device turns on when objects 1, 2, 3, and 4 are all placed together.
Announce: relevant=[object 2, object 3, object 5]; rule=objects 2, 3, and 5 must all be placed together (additional objects are allowed)

Announce: relevant=[object 6, object 7]; rule=objects 6 and 7 must be present. If total objects <7, both object 0 and object 1 must be present. If total objects =7, object 1 must be present and object 0 must be absent.
Announce: relevant=[object 0, object 2, object 4, object 6]; rule=all four even-numbered objects (0, 2, 4, 6) must be placed together; additional objects have no effect
Announce: relevant=[object 0, object 1, object 2]; rule=the device turns on if and only if object 0, object 1, and object 2 are all included in the set.
Announce: relevant=[object 0, object 1, object 4]; rule=the device turns on if and only if objects 0, 1, and 4 are all placed together. Other objects have no effect.
Announce: relevant=[object 0, object 1, object 6]; rule=device turns on if and only if objects 0, 1, and 6 are all placed on it — other objects have no effect

Announce: relevant=[object 0, object 1, object 2, object 3, object 4]; rule=objects 0 and 1 must be present; if object 2 is present, object 4 must be included and object 3 must be excluded with ≥5 total objects; if object 2 is absent, object 4 must be included with ≥4 total objects regardless of object 3's presence
